# SmartHome IoT Platform - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import events, streamsources, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="SmartHome IoT Platform API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build an IoT smart home dashboard with devices, sensor telemetry streams, and th...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(events.router, prefix="/api/events", tags=["Event Management"])
app.include_router(streamsources.router, prefix="/api/streamsources", tags=["StreamSource Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "SmartHome IoT Platform", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to SmartHome IoT Platform API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for SmartHome IoT Platform
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    window_end = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

# Automated Integration Tests for SmartHome IoT Platform
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_events():
    res = client.get("/api/events/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_event():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Event", "name": "Automated Test Event", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/events/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Event" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Event"

def test_realtime_metrics():
    res = client.get("/api/events/realtime")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "events_per_sec" in res.json()

files.README.md:
# SmartHome IoT Platform

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["SmartHome IoT Platform Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smarthome-iot-platform`

# ShopVault E-Commerce Platform - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import products, orders, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="ShopVault E-Commerce Platform API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Create an e-commerce website for small businesses with user authentication, prod...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(products.router, prefix="/api/products", tags=["Product Management"])
app.include_router(orders.router, prefix="/api/orders", tags=["Order Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "ShopVault E-Commerce Platform", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to ShopVault E-Commerce Platform API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for ShopVault E-Commerce Platform
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)
    sku = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    stock_quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    total_amount = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    shipping_address = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class OrderItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order_items"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    product_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    unit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

# Automated Integration Tests for ShopVault E-Commerce Platform
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_products():
    res = client.get("/api/products/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_product():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Product", "name": "Automated Test Product", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/products/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Product" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Product"

def test_order_checkout():
    res = client.post("/api/products/1/checkout")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "paid"

files.README.md:
# ShopVault E-Commerce Platform

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: E-Commerce & Order Management Platform
- **Description**: Scalable digital commerce engine with product catalog, cart, and payment checkout sandbox.
- **Primary Entity**: `Product`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Product`, `Order`, `OrderItem`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS Multi-AZ
- **Cache**: None (catalog indexed directly in Postgres)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Customer Clients
    SHOPPER["Web Storefront (React 18)"]
    MOBILE["Mobile Responsive Web"]
  end

  subgraph Edge & API Gateway
    CDN["CloudFront / Edge CDN"]
    LB["Application Load Balancer"]
  end

  subgraph Core Microservices
    API["ShopVault E-Commerce Platform FastAPI Gateway"]
    CATALOG["Catalog & Inventory Service"]
    ORDER_SVC["Order Processing Service"]
    CHECKOUT_SVC["Checkout & Payment Gateway Sandbox"]
  end

  subgraph Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Products, Orders, OrderItems)")]
    S3[("S3 Bucket (Product Media Assets)")]
  end

  SHOPPER --> CDN --> LB --> API
  MOBILE --> LB --> API
  API --> CATALOG
  API --> ORDER_SVC
  API --> CHECKOUT_SVC
  CATALOG --> PG
  ORDER_SVC --> PG
  CHECKOUT_SVC --> PG
  CATALOG --> S3
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/shopvault-e-commerce-platform`

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {

}

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status

    title="SmartHome Live API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build an IoT smart home dashboard with devices, sensor telemetry streams, and th...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

files.README.md:
# SmartHome Live

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["SmartHome Live Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smarthome-live`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Task Management System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Task(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tasks"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    priority = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)

    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Category(Base):

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():

    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_tasks():
    res = client.get("/api/tasks/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_task():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Task", "name": "Automated Test Task", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}

    assert res.json()["status"] == "completed"

files.README.md:
# Task Management System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Task Management Application
- **Description**: Comprehensive collaborative task, priority, and deadline tracking platform.
- **Primary Entity**: `Task`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Task`, `Category`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate / Cloud Run
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 (RDS)
- **Cache**: None (unnecessary for standard task CRUD)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Client Tier
    WEB["React Task Kanban SPA"]
    MOB["Mobile Web Client"]
  end

  subgraph Ingress & Security
    ALB["Cloud Load Balancer (HTTPS)"]
    AUTH["JWT Auth & Session Guard"]
  end

  subgraph Application Microservice
    API["Task Management System FastAPI Service"]
    TASK_SVC["Task Lifecycle Manager"]
    FILTER_SVC["Priority & Status Filter Engine"]
  end

  subgraph Persistence Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 (Tasks, Users, Categories)")]
  end

  WEB --> ALB
  MOB --> ALB
  ALB --> AUTH
  AUTH --> API
  API --> TASK_SVC
  API --> FILTER_SVC
  TASK_SVC --> PG
  FILTER_SVC --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/task-management-system`

# SQLAlchemy Models for E-Commerce Platform
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Product(Base):
    __tablename__ = "products"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)
    sku = Column(String(100), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    stock_quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Order(Base):
    __tablename__ = "orders"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    total_amount = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    shipping_address = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class OrderItem(Base):
    __tablename__ = "order_items"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    order_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    product_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    quantity = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    unit_price = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():

    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_products():

    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_product():

files.README.md:
# E-Commerce Platform

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: E-Commerce & Order Management Platform
- **Description**: Scalable digital commerce engine with product catalog, cart, and payment checkout sandbox.
- **Primary Entity**: `Product`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Product`, `Order`, `OrderItem`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS Multi-AZ
- **Cache**: None (catalog indexed directly in Postgres)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Customer Clients
    SHOPPER["Web Storefront (React 18)"]
    MOBILE["Mobile Responsive Web"]
  end

  subgraph Edge & API Gateway
    CDN["CloudFront / Edge CDN"]
    LB["Application Load Balancer"]
  end

  subgraph Core Microservices
    API["E-Commerce Platform FastAPI Gateway"]
    CATALOG["Catalog & Inventory Service"]
    ORDER_SVC["Order Processing Service"]
    CHECKOUT_SVC["Checkout & Payment Gateway Sandbox"]
  end

  subgraph Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Products, Orders, OrderItems)")]
    S3[("S3 Bucket (Product Media Assets)")]
  end

  SHOPPER --> CDN --> LB --> API
  MOBILE --> LB --> API
  API --> CATALOG
  API --> ORDER_SVC
  API --> CHECKOUT_SVC
  CATALOG --> PG
  ORDER_SVC --> PG
  CHECKOUT_SVC --> PG
  CATALOG --> S3
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/e-commerce-platform`

# Student Learning Management System - Main Application Entrypoint
from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import courses, enrollments, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Student Learning Management System API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a student learning management system with students, instructors, courses, ...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(courses.router, prefix="/api/courses", tags=["Course Management"])
app.include_router(enrollments.router, prefix="/api/enrollments", tags=["Enrollment Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

@app.get("/health")
def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Student Learning Management System", "version": "1.0.0"}

@app.get("/")
def root():
    return {"message": "Welcome to Student Learning Management System API", "docs_url": "/docs"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Student Learning Management System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Course(Base):
    __tablename__ = "courses"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    code = Column(String(50), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    instructor_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    credits = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Enrollment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "enrollments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    course_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    enrolled_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)

class Assignment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "assignments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    course_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    due_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    max_points = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Submission(Base):
    __tablename__ = "submissions"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    assignment_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    student_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    content = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    grade = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

# Automated Integration Tests for Student Learning Management System
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_courses():
    res = client.get("/api/courses/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_course():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Course", "name": "Automated Test Course", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/courses/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Course" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Course"

def test_enroll_course():
    res = client.post("/api/courses/1/enroll")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "enrolled"

files.README.md:
# Student Learning Management System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Student Learning Management System
- **Description**: Academic learning platform with course enrollments, assignment submissions, and grading workflow.
- **Primary Entity**: `Course`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Course`, `Enrollment`, `Assignment`, `Submission`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph User Access
    STUDENT["Student Web Portal"]
    FACULTY["Instructor Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph API & Routing Tier
    ALB["Cloud Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["RBAC Guard (Student / Instructor)"]
    API["Student Learning Management System FastAPI Service"]
  end

  subgraph Academic Engines
    COURSE_MGR["Course & Enrollment Manager"]
    ASSIGN_MGR["Assignment & Deadline Tracker"]
    GRADE_ENGINE["Grading & Assessment Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Courses, Enrollments, Submissions)")]
    DOCS[("S3 Course Material & Files")]
  end

  STUDENT --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  FACULTY --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> COURSE_MGR
  API --> ASSIGN_MGR
  API --> GRADE_ENGINE
  COURSE_MGR --> PG
  ASSIGN_MGR --> PG
  GRADE_ENGINE --> PG
  COURSE_MGR --> DOCS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/student-learning-management-system`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Hospital Appointment System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Doctor(Base):
    __tablename__ = "doctors"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    specialty = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    license_number = Column(String(50), nullable=False, unique=True)
    room_number = Column(String(30), nullable=False)
    is_available = Column(Boolean, default=True)

class Patient(Base):
    __tablename__ = "patients"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    blood_group = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    emergency_contact = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    date_of_birth = Column(String(20), nullable=False)

class Appointment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "appointments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    doctor_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    patient_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    appointment_time = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    reason = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_doctors():
    res = client.get("/api/doctors/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_doctor():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Doctor", "name": "Automated Test Doctor", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/doctors/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Doctor" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Doctor"

def test_cancel_appointment():
    res = client.patch("/api/doctors/1/cancel")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "cancelled"

files.README.md:
# Hospital Appointment System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Hospital & Clinical Appointment System
- **Description**: Clinical scheduling engine managing doctor availability, patient profiles, and appointment bookings.
- **Primary Entity**: `Doctor`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Doctor`, `Patient`, `Appointment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate in Private Subnet
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with AES-256 Storage Encryption
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Clinical Clients
    PATIENT_PORTAL["Patient Booking Portal"]
    STAFF_DESK["Clinic Reception Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph Security & Perimeter
    WAF["AWS WAF (HIPAA Guard)"]
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["OAuth2 / JWT Identity Validator"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Layer
    API["Hospital Appointment System Clinical API"]
    SCHEDULER["Slot Availability & Booking Engine"]
    AUDIT["HIPAA Audit & Access Logger"]
  end

  subgraph Secure Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL RDS (AES-256 Encrypted at Rest)")]
    AUDIT_LOG[("CloudWatch Immutable Audit Trails")]
  end

  PATIENT_PORTAL --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  STAFF_DESK --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  API --> AUDIT
  SCHEDULER --> PG
  AUDIT --> AUDIT_LOG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/hospital-appointment-system`

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from typing import List
import os

from backend.routes import transactions, categories, auth

app = FastAPI(
    title="Personal Finance Tracker API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a personal finance tracker with transactions, categories, budgets, monthly...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(transactions.router, prefix="/api/transactions", tags=["Transaction Management"])
app.include_router(categories.router, prefix="/api/categories", tags=["Category Management"])
app.include_router(auth.router, prefix="/api/auth", tags=["Authentication"])

def health_check():
    return {"status": "healthy", "service": "Personal Finance Tracker", "version": "1.0.0"}

# SQLAlchemy Models for Personal Finance Tracker
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Category(Base):
    __tablename__ = "categories"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    color = Column(String(30), nullable=False)

class Transaction(Base):
    __tablename__ = "transactions"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    amount = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    transaction_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Budget(Base):
    __tablename__ = "budgets"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    category_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    monthly_limit = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    current_spent = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    month_year = Column(String(20), nullable=False)

# Automated Integration Tests for Personal Finance Tracker
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_transactions():
    res = client.get("/api/transactions/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_transaction():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Transaction", "name": "Automated Test Transaction", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/transactions/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Transaction" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Transaction"

def test_export_csv():
    res = client.get("/api/transactions/export-csv")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "text/csv" in res.headers["content-type"]

files.README.md:
# Personal Finance Tracker

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Personal Finance & Expense Tracker
- **Description**: Personal finance tracker managing transactions, monthly category budgets, and CSV export.
- **Primary Entity**: `Transaction`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Category`, `Transaction`, `Budget`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with Numeric Precisions
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Client App
    WEB["Personal Finance Web Dashboard"]
    EXPORT["CSV Exporter Stream"]
  end

  subgraph API & Services
    ALB["Load Balancer"]
    API["Personal Finance Tracker Financial Core API"]
    BUDGET_ENG["Budget Tracking & Cap Engine"]
    CSV_GEN["CSV Streaming Serializer"]
  end

  subgraph Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Transactions, Budgets, Categories)")]
  end

  WEB --> ALB --> API
  EXPORT --> ALB --> API
  API --> BUDGET_ENG
  API --> CSV_GEN
  BUDGET_ENG --> PG
  CSV_GEN --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/personal-finance-tracker`

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status

app = FastAPI(
    title="Smart Home Dashboard API",
    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Build a smart home dashboard with rooms, devices, device status, monitoring, and...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],

)

app.include_router(devices.router, prefix="/api/devices", tags=["Device Management"])

# SQLAlchemy Models for Smart Home Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Device(Base):
    __tablename__ = "devices"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    device_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    room = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class SensorReading(Base):
    __tablename__ = "sensor_readings"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    unit = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class AlertRule(Base):
    __tablename__ = "alert_rules"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    device_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    metric = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    condition = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    threshold = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Smart Home Dashboard
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_devices():
    res = client.get("/api/devices/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_device():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Device", "name": "Automated Test Device", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/devices/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Device" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Device"

def test_ingest_telemetry():
    res = client.post("/api/devices/1/telemetry", json={"metric": "temperature", "value": 24.5})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "ingested"

files.README.md:
# Smart Home Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Smart Home IoT & Telemetry Platform
- **Description**: Smart home telemetry hub managing device registrations, live sensor streams, and threshold alerts.
- **Primary Entity**: `Device`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Device`, `SensorReading`, `AlertRule`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Ingestion Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 with Time-Series B-tree Indexes
- **Cache**: None (direct indexing with time buckets)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph IoT Hardware & Edge
    DEV1["Smart Thermostats"]
    DEV2["Environmental Air Sensors"]
    DEV3["Smart Energy Plugs"]
  end

  subgraph Edge Protocols & Gateway
    MQTT["MQTT Broker / IoT Core Gateway"]
    HTTPS["Ingress API Gateway (HTTPS)"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Processing
    API["Smart Home Dashboard Ingestion Engine"]
    RULE_ENG["Threshold Alert Rule Evaluator"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    TS_DB[("PostgreSQL Time-Series Tables")]
    ALERTS[("Alert Notification Queue")]
  end

  DEV1 --> MQTT --> API
  DEV2 --> HTTPS --> API
  DEV3 --> MQTT --> API
  API --> RULE_ENG
  API --> TS_DB
  RULE_ENG --> ALERTS
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/smart-home-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class StreamSource(Base):
    __tablename__ = "stream_sources"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    api_key_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    events_per_sec = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Event(Base):
    __tablename__ = "events"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    source_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    event_type = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    payload_json = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    timestamp = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    ip_address = Column(String(45), nullable=False)

class MetricAggregation(Base):
    __tablename__ = "metric_aggregations"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    metric_name = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    window_interval = Column(String(20), nullable=False)
    count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    sum_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    avg_value = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    window_end = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

files.README.md:
# Real-Time Analytics Dashboard

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Real-Time Event Stream Analytics Platform
- **Description**: High-velocity streaming platform with Redis stream buffer, sliding window metrics, and cold PostgreSQL storage.
- **Primary Entity**: `Event`
- **Entities**: `User`, `StreamSource`, `Event`, `MetricAggregation`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate High-Concurrency Workers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS (Permanent Cold Storage)
- **Cache**: Redis 7 Cluster (Stream Buffer & In-Memory Real-time Aggregates - Justified)
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Event Producers
    APP["Web & Mobile Apps"]
    SRV["Backend Microservices"]
    IOT["Edge Sensor Gateways"]
  end

  subgraph Ingestion & Caching (Redis Justified)
    LB["High-Throughput NLB"]
    API["Real-Time Analytics Dashboard Ingestion Gateway"]
    REDIS_STREAM[("Redis 7 Ingestion Buffer & Aggregate Cache")]
  end

  subgraph Worker & Aggregation
    AGGREGATOR["Stream Sliding-Window Aggregator Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Permanent Archival
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 Columnar/Timeseries Archival")]
    DASH["Live Stream Analytics Dashboard"]
  end

  APP --> LB --> API
  SRV --> LB --> API
  IOT --> LB --> API
  API --> REDIS_STREAM
  REDIS_STREAM --> AGGREGATOR
  AGGREGATOR --> REDIS_STREAM
  AGGREGATOR --> PG
  DASH --> REDIS_STREAM
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/real-time-analytics-dashboard`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Customer Support Ticket System
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Department(Base):
    __tablename__ = "departments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    name = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    sla_hours = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Ticket(Base):
    __tablename__ = "tickets"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    customer_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    assigned_agent_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    department = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    subject = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    priority = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    sla_deadline = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    updated_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class TicketComment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "ticket_comments"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    ticket_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    content = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    is_internal = Column(Boolean, default=True)

# Automated Integration Tests for Customer Support Ticket System
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_tickets():
    res = client.get("/api/tickets/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_ticket():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Ticket", "name": "Automated Test Ticket", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/tickets/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Ticket" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Ticket"

def test_assign_ticket():
    res = client.patch("/api/tickets/1/assign?agent_id=3")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["assigned_agent_id"] == 3

files.README.md:
# Customer Support Ticket System

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Customer Support & SLA Ticket System
- **Description**: Enterprise customer support desk with ticket queues, agent assignment, comment threads, and SLA tracking.
- **Primary Entity**: `Ticket`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Department`, `Ticket`, `TicketComment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Ticket Channels
    USER["Customer Help Center"]
    AGENT["Support Agent Workspace"]
  end

  subgraph Ingress & Identity
    ALB["Cloud Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["RBAC (Customer / Agent / Admin)"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Core
    API["Customer Support Ticket System Ticket Core API"]
    SLA["SLA Breached Deadline Monitor"]
    NOTIF["Email / Webhook Notification Worker"]
  end

  subgraph Relational Database
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Tickets, Comments, Departments)")]
  end

  USER --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  AGENT --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SLA
  API --> NOTIF
  SLA --> PG
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/customer-support-ticket-system`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Employee Attendance Management
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Employee(Base):
    __tablename__ = "employees"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    employee_code = Column(String(50), nullable=False, unique=True)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    department = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    designation = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    leave_balance = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

class Attendance(Base):
    __tablename__ = "attendance"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    employee_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    clock_in = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    clock_out = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)

class LeaveRequest(Base):
    __tablename__ = "leave_requests"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    employee_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    leave_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    start_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    end_date = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)
    days_count = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    reason = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_employees():
    res = client.get("/api/employees/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_employee():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Employee", "name": "Automated Test Employee", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/employees/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Employee" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Employee"

def test_clock_in():
    res = client.post("/api/employees/clock-in?employee_id=1")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "present"

files.README.md:
# Employee Attendance Management

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Employee Attendance & Leave Management System
- **Description**: Workforce management portal with time clocking, monthly attendance timesheets, and leave approval workflows.
- **Primary Entity**: `Employee`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Employee`, `Attendance`, `LeaveRequest`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Employee Access
    PORTAL["Employee Self-Service Web"]
    HR_DESK["HR Manager Approval Console"]
  end

  subgraph Identity & Load Balancing
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["JWT Role-Based Auth Guard"]
  end

  subgraph Core HR Services
    API["Employee Attendance Management HR Service"]
    TIME_CLOCK["Attendance Punch Engine"]
    LEAVE_MGR["Leave Balance Deductor"]
  end

  subgraph Persistence
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Employees, Attendance, LeaveRequests)")]
  end

  PORTAL --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  HR_DESK --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> TIME_CLOCK
  API --> LEAVE_MGR
  TIME_CLOCK --> PG
  LEAVE_MGR --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/employee-attendance-management`

# SQLAlchemy Models for Website Uptime Monitoring
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class MonitoredUrl(Base):
    __tablename__ = "monitored_urls"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    url = Column(String(500), nullable=False, index=True)
    check_interval_seconds = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    expected_status_code = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    timeout_seconds = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    is_active = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class UptimeCheck(Base):
    __tablename__ = "uptime_checks"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    url_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    status_code = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    response_time_ms = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=0.0)
    is_up = Column(Boolean, default=True)
    checked_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Incident(Base):

    started_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

files.README.md:
# Website Uptime Monitoring

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Website Uptime & Latency Monitoring System
- **Description**: Reliability and synthetic uptime prober tracking URL availability, response latency, and outage incidents.
- **Primary Entity**: `MonitoredUrl`
- **Entities**: `User`, `MonitoredUrl`, `UptimeCheck`, `Incident`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate Synthetic Probers
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS Time-Series
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph DevOps Engineers
    DASH["Uptime Status Page (React 18)"]
    ALERTS["Slack / PagerDuty Webhooks"]
  end

  subgraph Ingress & SRE Services
    ALB["Load Balancer"]
    API["Website Uptime Monitoring Uptime Controller"]
    SCHEDULER["Cron Probe Scheduler"]
    PROBER["Asynchronous HTTP/TLS Prober Engine"]
  end

  subgraph Monitored Target Endpoints
    SITE1["https://api.payments.com"]
    SITE2["https://auth.enterprise.io"]
  end

  subgraph Telemetry Storage
    PG[("PostgreSQL (Monitors, Checks, Incidents)")]
  end

  DASH --> ALB --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  SCHEDULER --> PROBER
  PROBER --> SITE1
  PROBER --> SITE2
  PROBER --> PG
  PROBER --> ALERTS
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/website-uptime-monitoring`

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status

    description="Production API generated by AI Product Architect for: Design and build a scalable SaaS inventory and supply chain tracking system with...",
    version="1.0.0"
)

app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],

)

app.include_router(designs.router, prefix="/api/designs", tags=["Design Management"])

from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Design(Base):
    __tablename__ = "designs"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False, index=True)
    description = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)

# Automated Integration Tests for SupplyChainPro
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_designs():
    res = client.get("/api/designs/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_design():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Design", "name": "Automated Test Design", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/designs/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Design" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Design"

def test_status_toggle():
    res = client.patch("/api/designs/1/status?new_status=completed")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "completed"

files.README.md:
# SupplyChainPro

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: SupplyChainPro Platform
- **Description**: Tailored application for managing designs and build records.
- **Primary Entity**: `Design`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Design`, `Build`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate / Cloud Run
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Client Tier
    SPA["SupplyChainPro Web Interface"]
  end

  subgraph API Ingress
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["JWT Authentication Guard"]
    API["SupplyChainPro Microservice"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 (designs, builds)")]
  end

  SPA --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/supplychainpro`

files.README.md:
# TeleMed Portal

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Hospital & Clinical Appointment System
- **Description**: Clinical scheduling engine managing doctor availability, patient profiles, and appointment bookings.
- **Primary Entity**: `Doctor`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Doctor`, `Patient`, `Appointment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate in Private Subnet
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with AES-256 Storage Encryption
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Clinical Clients
    PATIENT_PORTAL["Patient Booking Portal"]
    STAFF_DESK["Clinic Reception Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph Security & Perimeter
    WAF["AWS WAF (HIPAA Guard)"]
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["OAuth2 / JWT Identity Validator"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Layer
    API["TeleMed Portal Clinical API"]
    SCHEDULER["Slot Availability & Booking Engine"]
    AUDIT["HIPAA Audit & Access Logger"]
  end

  subgraph Secure Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL RDS (AES-256 Encrypted at Rest)")]
    AUDIT_LOG[("CloudWatch Immutable Audit Trails")]
  end

  PATIENT_PORTAL --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  STAFF_DESK --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  API --> AUDIT
  SCHEDULER --> PG
  AUDIT --> AUDIT_LOG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/telemed-portal`

# SQLAlchemy Models for TeleMed Portal
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, Text, Float, Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
from datetime import datetime

Base = declarative_base()

class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    email = Column(String(255), nullable=False, unique=True, index=True)
    hashed_password = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    role = Column(String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=False, default=datetime.utcnow)

class Doctor(Base):
    __tablename__ = "doctors"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    specialty = Column(String(100), nullable=False, index=True)
    license_number = Column(String(50), nullable=False, unique=True)
    room_number = Column(String(30), nullable=False)
    is_available = Column(Boolean, default=True)

class Patient(Base):
    __tablename__ = "patients"

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
    user_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)
    name = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
    blood_group = Column(String(10), nullable=False)
    emergency_contact = Column(String(100), nullable=False)
    date_of_birth = Column(String(20), nullable=False)

class Appointment(Base):

    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)

    patient_id = Column(Integer, nullable=False, default=0)

    status = Column(String(50), nullable=False, index=True)

    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_doctors():

    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_doctor():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Doctor", "name": "Automated Test Doctor", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/doctors/", json=payload)

    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Doctor" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Doctor"

files.README.md:
# TeleMed Portal

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Hospital & Clinical Appointment System
- **Description**: Clinical scheduling engine managing doctor availability, patient profiles, and appointment bookings.
- **Primary Entity**: `Doctor`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Doctor`, `Patient`, `Appointment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate in Private Subnet
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with AES-256 Storage Encryption
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Clinical Clients
    PATIENT_PORTAL["Patient Booking Portal"]
    STAFF_DESK["Clinic Reception Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph Security & Perimeter
    WAF["AWS WAF (HIPAA Guard)"]
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["OAuth2 / JWT Identity Validator"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Layer
    API["TeleMed Portal Clinical API"]
    SCHEDULER["Slot Availability & Booking Engine"]
    AUDIT["HIPAA Audit & Access Logger"]
  end

  subgraph Secure Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL RDS (AES-256 Encrypted at Rest)")]
    AUDIT_LOG[("CloudWatch Immutable Audit Trails")]
  end

  PATIENT_PORTAL --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  STAFF_DESK --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  API --> AUDIT
  SCHEDULER --> PG
  AUDIT --> AUDIT_LOG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/telemed-portal`

files.README.md:
# SupplyChainPro

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: SupplyChainPro Platform
- **Description**: Tailored application for managing designs and build records.
- **Primary Entity**: `Design`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Design`, `Build`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate / Cloud Run
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Client Tier
    SPA["SupplyChainPro Web Interface"]
  end

  subgraph API Ingress
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["JWT Authentication Guard"]
    API["SupplyChainPro Microservice"]
  end

  subgraph Storage Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL 15 (designs, builds)")]
  end

  SPA --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> PG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/supplychainpro`

# TeleMed Portal

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Hospital & Clinical Appointment System
- **Description**: Clinical scheduling engine managing doctor availability, patient profiles, and appointment bookings.
- **Primary Entity**: `Doctor`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Doctor`, `Patient`, `Appointment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate in Private Subnet
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with AES-256 Storage Encryption
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Clinical Clients
    PATIENT_PORTAL["Patient Booking Portal"]
    STAFF_DESK["Clinic Reception Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph Security & Perimeter
    WAF["AWS WAF (HIPAA Guard)"]
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["OAuth2 / JWT Identity Validator"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Layer
    API["TeleMed Portal Clinical API"]
    SCHEDULER["Slot Availability & Booking Engine"]
    AUDIT["HIPAA Audit & Access Logger"]
  end

  subgraph Secure Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL RDS (AES-256 Encrypted at Rest)")]
    AUDIT_LOG[("CloudWatch Immutable Audit Trails")]
  end

  PATIENT_PORTAL --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  STAFF_DESK --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  API --> AUDIT
  SCHEDULER --> PG
  AUDIT --> AUDIT_LOG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/telemed-portal`

# Automated Integration Tests for TeleMed Portal
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_doctors():
    res = client.get("/api/doctors/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_doctor():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Doctor", "name": "Automated Test Doctor", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/doctors/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Doctor" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Doctor"

def test_cancel_appointment():
    res = client.patch("/api/doctors/1/cancel")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "cancelled"

files.README.md:
# TeleMed Portal

Production cloud microservice generated by **AI Product Architect**.

## Domain Overview
- **Domain Category**: Hospital & Clinical Appointment System
- **Description**: Clinical scheduling engine managing doctor availability, patient profiles, and appointment bookings.
- **Primary Entity**: `Doctor`
- **Entities**: `User`, `Doctor`, `Patient`, `Appointment`

## Architecture Specification
- **Compute**: AWS ECS Fargate in Private Subnet
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 RDS with AES-256 Storage Encryption
- **Cache**: None
- **Security**: JWT OAuth2 Bearer Tokens, Bcrypt Password Hashing, CORS Guards

## Architecture Topology
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  subgraph Clinical Clients
    PATIENT_PORTAL["Patient Booking Portal"]
    STAFF_DESK["Clinic Reception Dashboard"]
  end

  subgraph Security & Perimeter
    WAF["AWS WAF (HIPAA Guard)"]
    ALB["Application Load Balancer"]
    AUTH["OAuth2 / JWT Identity Validator"]
  end

  subgraph Microservice Layer
    API["TeleMed Portal Clinical API"]
    SCHEDULER["Slot Availability & Booking Engine"]
    AUDIT["HIPAA Audit & Access Logger"]
  end

  subgraph Secure Data Tier
    PG[("PostgreSQL RDS (AES-256 Encrypted at Rest)")]
    AUDIT_LOG[("CloudWatch Immutable Audit Trails")]
  end

  PATIENT_PORTAL --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  STAFF_DESK --> WAF --> ALB --> AUTH --> API
  API --> SCHEDULER
  API --> AUDIT
  SCHEDULER --> PG
  AUDIT --> AUDIT_LOG
```

## Quick Start
```bash
# 1. Run local multi-container environment
docker-compose up --build

# 2. Check Service Health
curl http://localhost:8000/health
```

## API Documentation
- Interactive Swagger UI: `http://localhost:8000/docs`
- Live Deployment Preview: `http://localhost:8000/preview/telemed-portal`

# Automated Integration Tests for SupplyChainPro
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from backend.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_health():
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "healthy"

def test_root():
    res = client.get("/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "Welcome" in res.json()["message"]

def test_auth_flow():
    res = client.post("/api/auth/login", json={"email": "test@enterprise.io", "password": "SecretPassword123"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert "access_token" in res.json()

def test_list_designs():
    res = client.get("/api/designs/")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert isinstance(res.json(), list)

def test_create_design():
    payload = {"title": "Automated Test Design", "name": "Automated Test Design", "description": "Verification Record", "priority": "high"}
    res = client.post("/api/designs/", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data.get("title") == "Automated Test Design" or data.get("name") == "Automated Test Design"

def test_status_toggle():
    res = client.patch("/api/designs/1/status?new_status=completed")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["status"] == "completed"
